clips.title: The story
paras: In the central Barrens, the hunt for Lok Orcbane reaches its end. His fall will weaken the Razormane raids, and you carry his severed head to Thork at the Crossroads.

Mangletooth, a captured Razormane quilboar held in a cage at Camp Taurajo, names Lok Orcbane as the chieftain directing attacks on Horde caravans. After you slay Lok deep in the southern thorn mazes, Mangletooth gives you the chieftain's skull. He finds it amusing that the orcs will benefit from betrayal within the tribe without knowing a captive quilboar helped them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take Lok's head to Thork in the Crossroads, traveler. He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words—ha, not that he would believe Mangletooth helped in such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed.
I will continue to bless you with Agamaggan's power for as long as I remain in this cage, traveler. Until then, farewell.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found the Razormane leader and killed him yourself, friend? Amazing.
I am without words, but that does not mean I am without thanks. The people of the Crossroads would do well to respect your strength.
I must admit, I thought the leader of these raids on our supply lines was another quilboar. Thank you again, friend.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
